gates.name: UNIT
gates.description: Unit tests pass across the package surface (passed == total run, no unexpected skips/errors).

gates.name: NUMERICAL_ORACLE
gates.description: Outputs match a trusted reference oracle (pandas/canonical semantics) within tolerance.

gates.name: PROPERTY
gates.description: Property/metamorphic invariants hold (idempotence, monotonicity, round-trip, shape preservation).

gates.name: CROSS_PACKAGE
gates.description: Cross-package contracts hold: factor_engine -> factor_preprocess -> factor_optimizer -> factor_assets -> quant_evaluator.

gates.name: LEAKAGE
gates.description: No look-ahead / PIT / label / temporal leakage in factors and labels.

gates.name: DETERMINISM
gates.description: Same inputs + same pinned environment yield bit-identical outputs across runs/threads.

gates.name: SERIALIZATION
gates.description: Factor/plan/runtime objects survive pickling / format round-trips losslessly.

gates.name: CHECKPOINT_RESUME
gates.description: Long pipeline can checkpoint and resume from the last successful step.

gates.name: FRESH_WHEEL
gates.description: Package installs from a freshly built wheel and passes import/smoke.

gates.name: ASHARE_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_GOLDEN
gates.description: Semantic-contract golden suite for A-share data semantics (bp Return, backward Close*Factor, PIT PubDate, fail-closed industry source, percent normalization, effective-time-only dividend, IsSuspend from StockDailyBar). Can PASS from contract/golden helpers.

gates.name: ASHARE_REAL_DATA_SHADOW
gates.description: Real-data shadow: A-share semantics reproduced against REAL pinned parquet rows (data/a_share/lqtp_data mirror). Requires actual local A-share data; any skip/NEEDS-WIRING/synthetic-only evidence is NOT a pass.
